description.value: The Strathcona Hotel is a downtown Victoria landmark operating since 1913, housing a hotel, nine bars, the Sticky Wicket (billed as Vancouver Island's biggest pub with live music and food), Big Bad John's legendary hillbilly bar, and Strath Liquor with a world-class whisky selection and focus on local BC wine, spirits, and ales. It anchors the 900-block of Douglas Street and draws a broad local and visitor crowd year-round. A touring cyclist arriving in Victoria would find it a convenient stop for food, drink, and supplies in the heart of downtown.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 71m; stands (2 spaces) at 72m. Total: 2 spaces.
